text:
suzanne (product): quick sync — we need a decision on the "fastpath" retention buckets for enterprise/legal-hold flows. proposal: Search (30d), Short-term archived (180d), Cold archival (7y). BYOK customers get same buckets but with key lifecycle preserved. need: rollout plan, migration risk, soc2 evidence packaging requirements.

arjun (eng): +1 on buckets but want to call out schema versioning. if we change audit_event -> add field `legal_hold_id` we should ship as v2 and support backfill. basic event example:
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_01F...",
  "ts": "2025-03-05T16:12:03Z",
  "user": "acct_123",
  "action": "model.generate",
  "audit_meta": { "model": "redwood-v1", "seq_len": 512 },
  "legal_hold_id": null,
  "retention_tier": "search"
}
```
We should gate read-by-version: old consumers fallback to `retention_tier` and ignore unknown fields.

mike (security): SOC2 ask: exported evidence must include immutable chain-of-custody metadata (who requested hold, timestamp, key id for BYOK). retention buckets ok but cold archival needs proof-of-storage (checksum + signed manifest). we also need an acceptance criterion: sample export -> verifier can validate manifest + signature for 3 sample customers.

olivia (ops): ops questions: how do we surface the fastpath to SRE during incident? propose a `legal-hold.fastpath` feature flag per-tenant. migration steps: 1) write new field on all new events, 2) backfill small window (7d) for canary tenants, 3) full backfill run with rate limit. rough storage delta: +8% meta data.

maya (legal): legal hold override: product needs an API that can pin retention indefinitely and generate a signed evidence bundle for legal team. also need TTL override audit trail. please include `legal_hold.reason_code` and `requester_org` fields in schema.

arjun (eng): for backfill plan: SQL-ish pseudo:
```sql
UPDATE audit_events SET retention_tier = CASE WHEN ts > now() - interval '30 days' THEN 'search' WHEN ts > now() - interval '180 days' THEN 'short' ELSE 'cold' END WHERE retention_tier IS NULL LIMIT 10000;
```
we'll run in waves. Canary: 5 tenants for 48h then 25% traffic for 1 week.

suzanne (product): decisions we need by EOW: (1) confirm buckets and durations, (2) sign-off on schema fields (`legal_hold_id`, `legal_hold.reason_code`, `requester_org`, `retention_tier`), (3) acceptance test definition for SOC2 evidence exports, (4) canary cadence.

mike (security): 👍 on fields. acceptance test: export bundle for 3 tenants (one BYOK, one standard, one govcloud) that includes manifest.json + signatures + key reference. verifier should check signatures and checksums within 24h.

olivia (ops): agree to canary: 5 tenants -> 25% -> full. ops will add `legal-hold.fastpath` FF and dashboard panel for stuck backfills. will estimate cost delta after we run canary.

suzanne (product): great — i'll whip up a short RFC and acceptance checklist. olivia/arjun/mike please add required migration runbooks. aiming for feature-gated beta next sprint. @deploy-bot tagging for release checklist prep. :rocket:

deploy-bot: noted — created ticket INF-2042 and scheduled a deploy-window placeholder for next sprint.

suzanne (product): thanks — will ping once RFC draft is ready for review.
